blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebuano standout Nic Cabañero is looking to cap his sensational debut MPBL season with a championship as Binan Tatak Gel guns for a massive upset against defending champion Quezon Province in the SportsPlus Maharlika Pilipinas Basketball League (MPBL) 2026 Season South Division Finals. Averaging 16.7 points per game, Cabañero has emerged as a leading candidate for the league’s Most Valuable Player award, making him the centerpiece of Binan’s bid to dethrone the defending champions in the best-of-five series, which opens Tuesday at 6:30 p.m. at the Quezon Convention Center in Lucena City.
